title: John Ford's prosecution

tellings.quote: governing body by poisoning his toothpaste with radioactive material.

plain: A UFO historian named Richard Dolan, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast in an episode about UFO secrecy, tells of the prosecution of a man named John Ford on Long Island, New York, in the 1990s. As Dolan describes it, the case involved a claim about poisoning a member of a local governing body by putting radioactive material in his toothpaste, and he mentions a woman named Elaine Douglas in connection with it. Dolan raises it as part of the darker side of the UFO story, though the telling leaves the details vague.
